evals.prompt: Generate the Elementor landing page for an isolated copy of the existing apache-spark-for-beginners course.

assertions.name: original-untouched
assertions.text: the original output/apache-spark-for-beginners/ directory was not modified

assertions.name: exclusive-outcome
assertions.text: exactly one of elementor/landing-page.json or elementor/REFERENCE_REQUIRED.md was produced

assertions.name: source-md-if-tier2
assertions.text: if landing-page.json was produced via tier 2, SOURCE.md exists naming the tier and specific source files used, and restates the unverified-draft caveat

assertions.name: validator-actually-run
assertions.text: scripts/validate_elementor_json.py was actually run against the output with a real, quoted pass/fail result

assertions.name: no-banned-widgets
assertions.text: if landing-page.json was produced, it contains no html/shortcode widgets and no <style>/<script> tags in settings

assertions.name: no-header-footer-nav
assertions.text: the page excludes header, logo, navigation, and global footer elements

assertions.name: correct-palette
assertions.text: any hardcoded hex colors used are from the live theme token set (e.g. #5A4FE5, #14151A, #FBFBF8, etc.), not the retired #3D73FF blue

assertions.name: no-fabrication
assertions.text: no fake statistics or testimonials appear in the generated copy

assertions.name: discloses-unverified-live-rendering
assertions.text: the report explicitly states that live-Elementor-editor rendering has not been verified
